subject.title: fix: derived caches wedge cloud-worker reconciliation and reclaim

question: Should cloud-worker workspace reconciliation permanently exclude every path under `node_modules` and every path segment ending in `.pyc` or `.pyo`, rather than limiting the invariant to narrower cache artifacts?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and workspace-content contract change; tests prove the proposed behavior but cannot determine whether all existing cloud-worker users should lose synchronization for these broad path classes.

options.title: Confirm broad derived-artifact invariant
options.body: Keep the shared fixed exclusions after an after-fix live reconciliation and reclaim proof demonstrates the intended user workflow.

options.title: Narrow the exclusion set
options.body: Limit exclusions to cache directories or other explicitly supported generated artifacts if ordinary workspace content can legitimately use the currently broad matching names.

recommendation.title: Confirm broad derived-artifact invariant
recommendation.body: Keep the shared fixed exclusions after an after-fix live reconciliation and reclaim proof demonstrates the intended user workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked incident report and proposed implementation frame the cloud-worker reconciliation contract that needs confirmation.
